recipes.name: Moong dal chilla + mint curd
steps: Soak moong dal 2 hours (or overnight), then grind with chilli and a little water to a smooth batter.
Stir in chopped onion, tomato, coriander and salt.
Spread a ladle thin on a hot greased tawa; cook 2 min a side until golden.
Blend mint into the curd with a pinch of salt and serve alongside.

recipes.name: Besan chilla stuffed with paneer
steps: Whisk besan, turmeric, salt and water into a pourable batter.
Add chopped tomato, capsicum and coriander.
Pour onto a hot greased tawa and spread thin.
Crumble paneer over one half, fold, and cook both sides till golden.

recipes.name: Kanda poha with peanuts
steps: Rinse poha in a strainer and let it soften for 5 minutes.
Roast peanuts in oil, then add mustard seeds, curry leaves and onion; sauté till soft.
Add peas, turmeric and salt, then the poha. Toss gently on low heat for 3 minutes.
Finish with lemon juice.

recipes.name: Vegetable upma
steps: Dry-roast rava till it smells nutty; set aside.
Splutter mustard seeds and curry leaves in oil, add onion, carrot and peas; cook 4 minutes.
Pour in 1 cup hot water per serving with salt and bring to a boil.
Stream in the rava while stirring; cover and cook 2 minutes.

recipes.name: Idli with sambar
steps: Steam the batter in greased idli moulds for 10–12 minutes.
Pressure-cook toor dal with turmeric for 3 whistles and mash.
Cook onion, tomato and pumpkin with sambar masala and tamarind water for 8 minutes.
Add the dal and simmer 5 minutes; serve hot with the idlis.

recipes.name: Masala oats
steps: Sauté onion, carrot and peas in oil for 3 minutes.
Add tomato, turmeric and salt and cook till soft.
Add oats and 1 cup water per serving; simmer 4 minutes, stirring.

recipes.name: Methi thepla + curd
steps: Mix atta, besan, chopped methi, turmeric, salt and a spoon of curd.
Knead into a soft dough with water; rest 10 minutes.
Roll thin and cook on a hot tawa with a few drops of oil till spotted on both sides.
Serve with the rest of the curd.

recipes.name: Egg bhurji + toast
steps: Sauté onion in oil till soft, add tomato, turmeric and salt.
Crack in the eggs and scramble on medium heat till just set.
Toast the bread and serve with the bhurji.

recipes.name: Ragi dosa + coconut chutney
steps: Whisk ragi, rava, curd, salt and water into a thin batter; rest 10 minutes.
Pour onto a very hot tawa in a spiral and drizzle oil; cook till crisp.
Grind coconut with chilli, salt and water for the chutney.

recipes.name: Tofu bhurji + jowar roti
steps: Knead jowar atta with warm water and pat into a roti; cook on a tawa.
Sauté onion, capsicum and tomato with turmeric and salt.
Crumble in the tofu and cook 4 minutes.

recipes.name: Sprouts chaat bowl
steps: Soak whole moong overnight, drain and keep covered for a day to sprout (or buy sprouts).
Steam the sprouts 5 minutes.
Toss with chopped onion, tomato, cucumber, pomegranate, lemon and salt.

recipes.name: Banana peanut-butter overnight oats
steps: Mix oats, milk and flaxseed in a jar.
Top with sliced banana and peanut butter.
Refrigerate overnight; eat cold.

recipes.name: Paneer paratha + curd
steps: Knead atta into a soft dough.
Mix grated paneer, chilli, coriander and salt for the filling.
Stuff, roll and cook on a tawa with a little oil till golden.
Serve with curd.

recipes.name: Masala omelette + apple
steps: Whisk eggs with chopped onion, tomato, capsicum and salt.
Cook in a hot oiled pan, fold, and serve with a sliced apple.

recipes.name: Dal tadka, jeera rice + salad
steps: Pressure-cook toor dal with turmeric and salt for 3 whistles.
Cook rice with a pinch of jeera.
Make a tadka: jeera, garlic, onion and tomato in ghee; pour over the dal and simmer 5 minutes.
Serve with sliced cucumber.

recipes.name: Rajma chawal + kachumber
steps: Soak rajma overnight; pressure-cook 6–7 whistles till soft.
Cook brown rice (it takes about 25 minutes).
Cook onion, ginger and garlic till brown, add tomato and garam masala till jammy.
Add rajma with its water; simmer 10 minutes. Serve with chopped cucumber.

recipes.name: Chole + phulka + salad
steps: Soak kabuli chana overnight; pressure-cook 5 whistles.
Cook onion and tomato with chole masala till oil separates.
Add chana and some cooking water; simmer 10 minutes.
Make phulkas from the atta and serve with cucumber.

recipes.name: Palak paneer + phulka
steps: Blanch spinach 2 minutes, cool and blend.
Cook onion, garlic and tomato, add the spinach purée and salt.
Add paneer cubes and simmer 5 minutes.
Serve with phulkas.

recipes.name: Sambar rice + beans poriyal
steps: Cook rice and toor dal separately.
Simmer pumpkin in tamarind water with sambar masala, then add the dal.
For poriyal, stir-fry chopped beans with mustard seeds and finish with coconut.
Serve sambar over rice with the poriyal.

recipes.name: Jowar bhakri + pitla + salad
steps: Knead jowar atta with hot water and pat into bhakris; cook on a tawa.
Temper mustard seeds, garlic and onion in oil.
Whisk besan with water, turmeric and salt; pour in and stir till thick and glossy.
Serve with cucumber.

recipes.name: Moong khichdi + kadhi
steps: Pressure-cook rice and moong dal with turmeric, salt and 3 cups water.
Whisk curd with besan and water; simmer 10 minutes, stirring.
Temper jeera and curry leaves in ghee and pour over the kadhi.

recipes.name: Home-style chicken curry + phulka
steps: Marinate chicken in curd, salt and chilli powder for 30 minutes (or overnight).
Brown onion in oil, add ginger, garlic and tomato; cook till jammy.
Add chicken and garam masala; cover and cook 20 minutes.
Serve with phulkas.

recipes.name: Bengali-style fish curry + rice
steps: Rub fish with turmeric and salt; shallow-fry 2 minutes a side.
Splutter mustard seeds, add onion and tomato and cook down.
Add 1 cup water, then the fish; simmer 8 minutes.
Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Soya chunk pulao + raita
steps: Soak soya chunks in hot water 10 minutes; squeeze dry.
Sauté onion, carrot, peas and soya with garam masala.
Add rinsed rice and water; cook till done.
Whisk curd with salt for the raita.

recipes.name: Tofu matar + phulka
steps: Cook onion and tomato with garam masala till jammy.
Add peas and a little water; simmer 5 minutes.
Add tofu cubes and cook 5 more minutes. Serve with phulkas.

recipes.name: Bhindi masala, masoor dal + phulka
steps: Pressure-cook masoor dal with turmeric and salt for 2 whistles.
Stir-fry sliced bhindi in oil on high heat till no longer sticky.
Add onion, tomato and dhania powder; cook 5 minutes.
Serve with dal and phulkas.

recipes.name: Egg curry + rice
steps: Boil eggs 10 minutes, peel and score.
Brown onion and ginger, add tomato and garam masala till thick.
Add water and the eggs; simmer 8 minutes. Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Curd rice + cucumber
steps: Cook rice soft and let it cool slightly.
Mix with curd, salt and grated cucumber.
Temper mustard seeds and curry leaves in oil and pour over; top with pomegranate.

recipes.name: Roasted makhana
steps: Roast makhana in a dry pan on low heat for 6 minutes till crisp.
Toss with a few drops of oil, pepper and salt.

recipes.name: Roasted chana + guava
steps: Slice the guava and eat with a handful of roasted chana.

recipes.name: Masala chaas + peanuts
steps: Whisk curd with water, roasted jeera powder and salt.
Have with a small handful of peanuts.

recipes.name: Paneer tikka bites
steps: Toss paneer, capsicum and onion with curd, chilli powder and salt.
Grill or pan-roast 6 minutes, turning once.

recipes.name: Papaya-banana bowl + seeds
steps: Cube papaya, slice banana, sprinkle pumpkin seeds.

recipes.name: Boiled eggs with pepper
steps: Boil eggs 9 minutes, cool, peel and season.

recipes.name: Sweet corn chaat
steps: Boil corn 5 minutes.
Toss with onion, tomato, lemon and salt.

recipes.name: Apple + peanut butter
steps: Slice the apple and dip in peanut butter.

recipes.name: Green tea + almonds
steps: Brew green tea 2 minutes; have with almonds.

recipes.name: Mixed veg, moong dal + phulka
steps: Pressure-cook moong dal with turmeric and salt.
Stir-fry carrot, peas and cauliflower with jeera till tender.
Serve with phulkas.

recipes.name: Vegetable dalia khichdi + curd
steps: Roast dalia in ghee with jeera for 2 minutes.
Add moong dal, vegetables, salt and 3 cups water; pressure-cook 3 whistles.
Serve with curd.

recipes.name: Grilled paneer + sautéed veg
steps: Season paneer slices with salt and pepper and pan-grill 2 minutes a side.
Sauté capsicum, mushroom and onion on high heat.
Plate together.

recipes.name: Grilled chicken + sautéed veg
steps: Marinate chicken in curd, lemon, chilli powder and salt for 20 minutes.
Pan-grill 5–6 minutes a side till cooked through.
Sauté capsicum and cabbage and serve alongside.

recipes.name: Ragi roti + dal palak
steps: Pressure-cook toor dal with turmeric.
Cook garlic and tomato, add chopped spinach till wilted, then the dal.
Knead ragi atta with hot water, pat into rotis and cook on a tawa.

recipes.name: Moong soup + tofu stir-fry
steps: Cook moong dal with extra water, ginger and salt into a thin soup; add pepper.
Stir-fry tofu, cabbage, capsicum and garlic on high heat for 5 minutes.

recipes.name: Bajra roti + lauki chana dal
steps: Pressure-cook chana dal and lauki with turmeric and salt for 3 whistles.
Temper jeera and tomato in oil and add to the dal.
Knead bajra atta with warm water, pat into rotis and cook on a tawa.

recipes.name: Fish tikka + salad
steps: Marinate fish in curd, lemon, chilli powder and salt for 15 minutes.
Pan-grill 3 minutes a side.
Serve with cucumber and tomato salad.

recipes.name: Masoor dal + jeera rice
steps: Cook masoor dal with turmeric and salt till soft.
Temper jeera, garlic, onion and tomato and stir into the dal.
Cook rice with jeera.

recipes.name: Aloo gobi, dal + phulka
steps: Cook masoor dal with turmeric and salt.
Cook potato and cauliflower with jeera, dhania powder and turmeric, covered, for 12 minutes.
Serve with phulkas.

recipes.name: Egg veggie wrap
steps: Make a roti from the atta.
Pour beaten eggs into a pan, lay the roti on top, flip and cook.
Fill with shredded cabbage, onion and capsicum and roll up.

recipes.name: Mushroom matar + jowar roti
steps: Cook onion and tomato with garam masala till jammy.
Add mushroom and peas; cook 8 minutes.
Serve with jowar rotis.

recipes.name: Chicken soup + stir-fried veg
steps: Simmer chicken with ginger, garlic, salt and 3 cups water for 20 minutes; shred.
Add pepper and chopped carrot to the soup.
Stir-fry cabbage separately.

recipes.name: Prawn masala + rice
steps: Cook onion and tomato with chilli powder and turmeric.
Add coconut and a splash of water, then prawns; cook 5 minutes.
Serve with rice.
